_schema.vehicle: {make, model, year, engine, market} -- the car this catalogue was compiled for

items[].id: stable row id; the per-VIN checklist status is keyed by it (required)
items[].kind: tsb | recall | csn | campaign | extended_warranty | emissions | field_report (sibling_engine only: forum/retailer claim, never verified)
items[].number: bulletin/recall number exactly as the rest of CUORE spells it (dossier tsb_matches, knowledge.py) -- cross-links match on it
items[].title: short title
items[].date: ISO date, or null when the repo has none
items[].summary: what it is for, in plain words
items[].condition: the symptom/condition the bulletin addresses, or null
items[].remedy: what the dealer/mechanic does, or null
items[].links: [{label, url}] or null when no link is on file
items[].applies: yes | no | vin_check -- does it apply to this car
items[].source: where the facts in this row came from
items[].verified: true when the source document itself was read; false when only indexed/inferred
items[].components: optional: part names/numbers the bulletin inspects, replaces or flashes
items[].symptoms: optional: plain-words symptoms/conditions the bulletin addresses
items[].repair_implied: optional: flash | replace:<part> | procedure:<name> | inspect | software_update | none
items[].depends_on_systems: optional: system keys (mes.systems.SYSTEMS, e.g. evap, fuel, engine_management) that are affected / must be healthy
items[].vehicle_scope: this_model (default; a bulletin for this car) | sibling_engine (ANALOGUE: a bulletin/recall/field report from another model with the same FCA GME-T4 2.0L engine family; never a Stelvio bulletin, ranked below Stelvio rows)
items[].sibling_vehicle: sibling_engine rows: '<model years engine>' the bulletin was written for
items[].transferability: sibling_engine rows: 'inference: ...' why the analogue may or may not carry over to this car
items[].stelvio_equivalent: sibling_engine rows: number of the catalogue row for this car it parallels (linked in the cross-reference), or null
items[].also_applies_to: this_model rows: list of sibling vehicles the same bulletin number also covers
items[].fca_number: optional: the manufacturer's own campaign code when it differs from number/nhtsa_id (e.g. 93C for NHTSA 25V586); the same campaign, never a separate row

_schema.notes: Extra fields are tolerated and passed through; only id is required. Merge steps append rows to items[] and must keep ids unique. cuore_relevance, applies_to, transport_canada_id and similar extras are optional and ignored by the template.

items.title: Flash: Powertrain Diagnostic and System Improvements (NHTSA copy is REV. D, Giulia-only)
items.summary: The bulletin the project cited as the basis for the ECM-calibration verdict. The NHTSA copy (10216318) is REV. D and covers the 2017 Alfa Romeo GIULIA 2.0L I4 DI Turbo (EC2) built on or before 2017-06-29 only; Stelvio is NOT listed in the opened document and no Stelvio copy of 18-030-17 was found. Applicability to this car is unconfirmed, check by VIN/dealer. The directly applicable 2018 Stelvio ECM flash bulletin is 18-026-20, which lists P1CEA/P24D6 but not P0440/P0455/P0456.

items.remedy: Reprogram ECM with latest software via wiTECH 2 (charger 13.2-13.5 V, flash about 9 min), run ECM Misc Functions Phonic Wheel Replacement (otherwise P1300 stays active), clear DTCs. Labour 18-19-06-SK inspect 0.2 h; 18-19-06-TW inspect and reprogram 0.4 h. Also RRT 17-043.

items.title: EVAP small-leak verification requires wiTECH SLVT
items.summary: The Small Leak Verification Test (SLVT). A road test cannot confirm a small EVAP leak repair; the dealer's wiTECH SLVT procedure is the verification. Mode $06 is the only non-dealer route to the measured value. Applies to 2012-2023 Stellantis US gas vehicles with SLVT (2012-2023 ALL; Stelvio not named individually); supersedes 18-095-21 (which superseded 18-089-19). SLVT must run first to confirm a leak and again after any repair or component replacement, including PCM software updates. NHTSA flat-file records: MC-10236933-9999 2023-04-15 (1804823). NHTSA flat-file records: MC-10236933-9999 2023-04-15 (1804823).
items.condition: Confirming a small EVAP leak (P0456) repair.
items.remedy: Run the wiTECH Small Leak Verification Test after the repair.
items.source: docs/research/EVAP_STELVIO.md (bulletin number 1804823); docs/reference/TSB_CATALOGUE.md section 2; cuore/web/templates/dealer.html; NHTSA PDF 10236933 opened in full (research 2026-10-15)
items.cuore_relevance: The acceptance test for the EVAP job: SLVT pass is the proof of fix.
symptoms: P0456 small leak repair cannot be confirmed by road test
also_applies_to: 2012-2023 all Stellantis gas vehicles with wiTECH SLVT (incl. Alfa dealers if on wiTECH)

items.title: Hard to fill / EVAP canister flooded with fuel
items.summary: Hard-to-fill diagnostic tree. A vapour line disconnected inside the tank at the fuel delivery module (FDM) port floods the EVAP canister with liquid fuel (fuel, not water).
items.condition: Hard to fill; canister or recirculation line found with fuel in it.
items.remedy: Check the clean-air hose ESIM to EVAP filter, the EVAP filter, and the tank-to-canister vapour hose; if fuel is found, drop the fuel tank, remove the FDM lock ring, check the internal vapour line at the FDM port, and replace BOTH the vapour canister and the ESIM.
items.source: docs/research/EVAP_STELVIO.md (covers GU 18-24 and GA; PDF retrieved); docs/reference/TSB_CATALOGUE.md section 2
items.research_note_2026_10_15: A later research pass could not find 9100471 on NHTSA or via search, so nothing was re-opened; the earlier retrieval recorded in the source field stands. Not re-verified.
symptoms: fuel in EVAP canister or recirculation line

items.title: IBS: Start-Stop charging lamp, SOC inaccurate, B2193 / U113E / P00FD
items.summary: STAR case, revised to Rev H. The IBS measures voltage, current and temperature; do not replace it without DTCs. SOC adaptation needs one crank and 2-4 hours of quiescent time (battery current between -500 mA and +50 mA). B2193 (IBS internal): cycle the two-way connection, start, wait 30 s, replace only if still active. U113E: LIN bus fault; wiggle test, fuse, voltage above 11.8 V at pin 2, scope the LIN. P00FD is the ECM aux versus main battery voltage delta, never an IBS fault; it latches until cleared. Do not blind charge: clamp negative to body or engine ground, or through the IBS.
items.condition: Charging lamp, SOC wrong, IBS DTCs.
